Row.Text: 自动安排生产、区域建设、建造者改良与移民扩张，均支付正常成本。军队行动由你指挥，可随时暂停城市或文职托管。[NEWLINE]开发原型：有偿夺取仍在引擎验证中，当前不收取相关费用。

Automatically plans production, districts, builder improvements and peaceful settlement at normal costs. You command the army and may take over any city or civilian.[NEWLINE]Development prototype: paid acquisition is under engine validation; no acquisition fees are charged.
白绮，令城市为你运转，率军亲临战场。为我前驱。
Baiqi, let your cities work while you lead the army. Go forth for me.
